title: Alphabet Blocks (Port)
description: A port of a mod by DragonSlayr15001, made for the Fabric mod loader.
body:
![Alphabet Blocks Logo, which is "Alphabet Blocks" written in colorful bold lettering](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https%3A%2F%2Ffile.garden%2FZWRLDl4ycxnRjvXs%2Fminecraft-alphabetblocks.png&n=-1)

This mod ports over all of the blocks and crafting recipes from [Alphabet Blocks by DragonSlayr15001](https://modrinth.com/mod/alphabet-blocks).

I did not make any of the assets nor did I modify any of the functionality (at least as far as I am aware!), so if you were wanting to use this mod in your own Fabric modpack like I was but saw it was Forge only, this port is for you!

Per the description of the original:

"This is a small mod that adds a few letter blocks for decoration. I based these textures on a real set of letter block toys; the fact that the J block is green like JEI's logo is coincidence."
